d:
Tyohar par bina pyaaz-lahsun Dal Bafla – fry ya air fryer, dono mein perfect!
Pachmel dal + layer wale baafle, kadhi-gatte ki zaroorat nahi
dal baphla resipi – 5 dalon ki pachmel dal (4-5 members)
Layer wale baafle – 2 tarike (roll aur strips)
Baafle fry ya air fryer mein – dono tarike
Namaste, main Poonam Devnani – Masala Kitchen par aaj Dal Bafla bina pyaaz-lahsun ke. Comment karein – baafle fry pasand hain ya air fryer wale?
